Callout.Name: Robbery in a Small Town
Callout.Message: Hold-up at a gas station in a small town.
Callout.Advisory: One male, cash taken, clerk unhurt.

Lines.Approach: He took the till and walked out. Clerk is shaken and the town has two roads out, so pick one.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
